about: Shared cases for the participants rule: the engine's names.participants / names.is_generic and the app's CallParticipants.derived / Voices.isGenericLabel run the same cases (engine/tests/test_names.py, Tests/SozvonCoreTests/CallsWindowTests.swift).

participants.note: speaking order first, then typed names that never spoke; generic labels and the user stay out
a typed name in another case is the same person, in the speaker's spelling
a typed first name folds into the one fuller speaking name
two speaking names start with the typed first name: it is not folded
a typed full name is never folded
extra spaces are squeezed; the user's own typed name and generic typed labels are dropped
a person whose lines were all given to someone else is gone (only typed names stay)
no transcript yet: the typed names
